title.zh: Circle launches 24/7 stablecoin FX engine as it chases a slice of the $10 trillion currency market
title.en: Circle launches 24/7 stablecoin FX engine as it chases a slice of the $10 trillion currency market

current_state.zh: Circle launched StableFX on its Arc blockchain, a 24/7 stablecoin foreign-exchange engine that lets vetted businesses request competing liquidity-provider quotes and settle both legs of a currency trade atomically, targeting the nearly $10 trillion-a-day FX market that still runs on banking-hour infrastructure.
